mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days as investors anticipate near-term corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises (monthly change > 0) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (year-over-year) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations through low discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.
